product.title: Half Day Guided Whitewater Rafting in Moab

description.text: Navigate the thrilling waters of the Colorado River on a half-day whitewater rafting adventure in Moab, Utah. Starting at the exhilarating Onion Creek Rapid, this 4-hour trip features class II/III rapids that promise both excitement and stunning views of the majestic red rock formations. With all gear provided and expert guidance, you'll paddle through the Fisher Tower's section, making memories with every splash. Ideal for travelers basing in Moab who want a guided Utah adventure without self-driving backcountry roads or river put-ins.
